subject: On the borderline
author: ZombieTron
body:
The palm bay ones are tricky! I think there are some which seem like they are in palm bay, but are actually in harbour town.

If you are on PS3 you can use the game analyzer over at criteriongames.com other wise try our map or the map that senocular made on our links page.

The video guide over at criteriongames.com really helped me with my palm bay jump. check it out:

http://www.criteriongames.com/burnout/paradise/guides/superjumps/

Good Luck! 🙂

--- The Original and the Best ---
